protocol: Reset before each conversation. Each follow-up receives the prior generated reply only if the chat CLI retains it. The book checkpoint uses its own vocabulary and the same chat prompt and decoder for comparison.

scoring.correct: Manual review. The reply must convey the reference answer without contradicting it. Equivalent wording and unambiguous spelling errors are allowed.
scoring.ended_with_marker: Generation emitted the full end-of-turn marker before reaching or at the generation limit.
scoring.clean_stop: Generation emitted the full end-of-turn marker and did not show a stray marker fragment in the reply.
scoring.history_used: The previous exchange was present in the model input for a follow-up.
scoring.reply_loss: Mean cross-entropy of reference reply characters and the end marker when supplied with the reference context.
